summary: Keeps the plugin installer, runtime, RBAC, and Plugin Manager Helm chart versions aligned for protected release-candidate qualification and publication.
userImpact: The plugin toolchain can be staged and published as one coherent set instead of failing release qualification because package and chart versions differ.

instructions: Use plugin runtime and installer RBAC charts 0.2.7 with @enterpriseglue/plugin-installer 0.2.7, and use the Plugin Manager chart 0.1.7 with @enterpriseglue/plugin-manager 0.1.7.

security: Release qualification continues to fail closed unless package, chart, and image version subjects form a coordinated immutable toolchain.
documentation: Generated release notes record the matching plugin package and Helm chart versions required for deployment.
rollback: Before publication, revert the chart metadata and matching package-version changes together; after immutable publication, correct any artifact defect with a new forward version.
validation: Plugin-toolchain release-policy checks validate live package and chart metadata before expensive candidate builds.
Release-candidate chart planning compares all three new chart versions with the immutable OCI registry without publishing.
Helm lint and plugin-platform chart tests cover the aligned runtime, RBAC, and Plugin Manager charts.
